suggested_backlog.action: Review dependency compatibility and upgrade the relevant graph; OSV lists stable fixed boundaries rustls 0.23.46 and rustls-webpki 0.103.16. Do not blindly force transitive versions.
suggested_backlog.gate: Exact-version OSV recheck excludes the four rustls issue groups and RUSTSEC-2026-0382; guest build/tests and TLS rejection/handshake/session regression evidence on supported targets; reviewer checks actual enabled features and attack surfaces.

suggested_backlog.title: Resolve cxx and tokio soundness advisories
suggested_backlog.action: Review RUSTSEC-2026-0202 and RUSTSEC-2026-0386; OSV fixed boundaries include cxx 1.0.195 and tokio 1.53.3 (also an older tokio maintenance branch). Establish API/feature applicability before updating.
suggested_backlog.gate: Locked graph no longer matches those advisory IDs, supported-target build/tests pass, and reviewer records affected FFI exception/I/O-safety reachability.

suggested_backlog.gate: Dependency removed/replaced with regression coverage for PEM parsing, or explicit dated owner risk review; no blanket advisory suppression.

suggested_backlog.title: Produce exact Python dependency inventory and complete Linux test evidence
suggested_backlog.action: Create/review reproducible exact Python dependency inventory in the normal development workflow; rerun the complete host suite with required dependencies/plugins. Obtain real guest/GUI Rust build/test evidence on supported targets.
suggested_backlog.gate: Full host collection and required tests pass, missing dependencies/plugins are resolved in a reviewed environment, exact Python versions are scanned, and Rust evidence is actual execution rather than metadata or mocks. Preserve the current partial result until replaced.

suggested_backlog.title: Close the historical gate-template secret-pattern candidate
suggested_backlog.action: Owner reviews the redacted historical candidate and template purpose; determine whether it is an intentional example or any credential ever had a usable scope. No value is published.
suggested_backlog.gate: Documented non-credential/test-example rationale, or credential revocation/rotation plus exposure review if confirmed; rerun the detector without silently dropping the finding.
